steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Obesity: BMI over 30. Affects 28% of UK adults and rising in children. Caused by sustained positive energy balance (calories in exceed calories out). Increases risk of type 2 diabetes, heart disease, stroke, and certain cancers.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Type 2 diabetes: the body becomes resistant to insulin or doesn't produce enough. Strongly linked to obesity, physical inactivity, and diets high in sugar and refined carbohydrates. Management includes weight loss, exercise, and reduced sugar intake.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cardiovascular disease (CVD): includes heart disease and stroke. Risk factors include high blood pressure, high LDL cholesterol, smoking, obesity, and physical inactivity. Diet influences: excess saturated fat raises LDL cholesterol; excess salt raises blood pressure; fruit and vegetables provide antioxidants.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Tooth decay (dental caries): caused by bacteria fermenting sugars to produce acid that erodes tooth enamel. Frequency of sugar consumption matters more than total amount. Prevention: reduce sugar frequency, brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste, visit the dentist.

steps.body: Always give specific dietary recommendations for each health condition Use statistics where possible (e.g. 28% UK adult obesity rate) Discuss prevention AND management of diet-related conditions
